Your voice in shaping St Joseph’s future Dear friends, In 2027, St Joseph’s will hold its first Parish Assembly: a gathering of the whole parish community to reflect together on who we are and where we are going. It is part of Building Hope , the Archdiocese of Dublin’s call to every parish to become a place of listening, co-responsibility and shared mission. An Assembly is only as good as the listening that comes before it. So before we gather, we want to hear from you. The Parish Pastoral Council has put together a short survey of seven questions, which takes about five minutes. Your answers will directly shape what the Assembly discusses. We especially want to hear from people who don’t usually get asked: fresh voices and quieter voices, those at the heart of parish life and those at its edges. Every response counts the same.
